evidence.scope: Real local PostgreSQL transaction and management service integration with synthetic records only
evidence.server: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
cases: read-only preflight detects a missing schema without creating tables
real PostgreSQL migration applies once and repeats safely
read-only preflight confirms migration and detects checksum drift
existing migration v1 upgrades to finance v2 without changing prior management records
SQL transaction rolls back all writes after failure
real advisory locks serialize concurrent read-modify-write
concurrent duplicate event ingestion stores and counts one event
changed payload under same event ID is quarantined without replacing original
invalid event batch has no partial committed events
concurrent expected-revision configuration changes admit one editor
configuration projection confirms matching revision and hash
applied receipts are idempotent and unknown hashes are rejected
database constraints reject invalid event records
public HTTP ingestion acknowledges SQL persistence and duplicate retries with child/device context
SQL operation locks persist one dispatch and immutable audit across concurrent requests
real SQL finance commits once under concurrent retry and preserves correction revisions
real SQL finance import rolls back every ledger, version and audit write on storage failure
